==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|subordinat}}, from {{der|en|la-med|subōrdinātus}}, past participle of {{m|la|subordino|subōrdināre}}, from {{m|la|sub-}} + {{m|la|ordino|ōrdināre|to order}}.

===Pronunciation===
; Adjective and Noun
* {{enPR|sə-bôʹdĭ-nət|a=RP}}, {{IPA|en|/səˈbɔːdɪnət/}}
* {{enPR|sə-bôrʹdĭ-nət|a=GA,CA}}, {{IPA|en|/səˈbɔɹdɪnət/}}
* {{IPA|en|/səˈboːdɪnət/|a=AU}}
* {{IPA|en|/səˈboːdənət/|a=NZ}}
; Verb
* {{enPR|sə-bôʹdĭ-nāt|a=RP}}, {{IPA|en|/səˈbɔːdɪneɪt/}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-subordinate (verb).wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{enPR|sə-bôrʹdĭ-nāt|a=GA,CA}}, {{IPA|en|/səˈbɔɹdɪneɪt/}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-subordinate.ogg|a=Southern California}}
* {{IPA|en|/səˈboːdɪnæɪt/|a=AU}}
* {{IPA|en|/səˈboːdənæɪt/|a=NZ}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj}}

# [[place|Placed]] in a [[lower]] [[class]], [[rank]], or [[position]].
#: {{syn|en|lesser|subaltern|petty}}
#: {{ant|en|superior|superordinate}}
#* {{RQ:Woodward Natural History|passage=The several kinds {{...}} and '''subordinate''' species of each are easily known.}}
# [[submissive|Submissive]] or [[inferior]] to, or [[control]]led by [[authority]].
#: {{ant|en|insubordinate}}
#* '''November 9, 1662''', {{w|Robert South}}, ''Of the Creation of Man in the Image of God''
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1978|last=Kołakowski|first=Leszek|authorlink=Leszek Kołakowski|title=w:Main Currents of Marxism|volume=III: The Breakdown|origlang=pl|original=Główne nurty marksizmu: rozkład|translator=P[aul] S[teven] Falla|origyear=1976|publisher=w:Clarendon Press|location=w:Oxford|isbn=9780198245704|oclc=59183135|page=245|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/maincurrentsofma00kola/page/245|passage=However, his main point is clearly that the political organization should be '''subordinate''' to the real aspirations of the working class and should not be allowed to claim that it expresses those aspirations by virtue of its own 'scientific' omniscience, regardless of what the empirical 'masses' actually think.}}
# {{lb|en|grammar|of a clause|not comparable}} [[dependent]] on and either modifying or complementing the main clause
#: {{syn|en|dependent}}
#: {{ant|en|independent|main}}
#: {{ux|en|In the sentence “The barbecue finished before John arrived”, the '''subordinate''' clause “before John arrived” specifies the time of the main clause, “The barbecue finished”.}}
# [[descend|Descending]] in a [[regular]] [[series]].
